options.name: Birds of Casco Bay - Boat Tour

services.name: Birds of Casco Bay - Boat Tour
services.desc: Join the crew of Seacoast Tours and Derek Lovitch from Freeport Wild Bird Supply on a special tour of the islands and waters of Casco Bay. Adult (Ages 12+) - $45 Child (Ages 2-11) - $25 2.5 Hours About We’ll explore the inner islands of Freeport, Brunswick and Harpswell as we search for osprey, eagles, eiders, Common Terns, and an occasional seal basking in the sun on the ledges of hidden coves. We’ll focus on the common breeding water and shoreline birds of the region, including photographic opportunities whenever we can, but without disturbing any nests. Conditions and tide Starting at $25 · 2.5 Hours · Explore Freeport, Brunswick, and Harpswell!

services.name: Lobstering Demo & Wildlife Cruises
services.desc: Lobstering & Wildlife Cruise Adults: $50 Children: $35 Children Under 2: FREE 2 Hours. About Explore the mysteries of Casco Bay: Learn about lobsters, watch for seals, shore birds and other marine wildlife while winding our way through the islands. Time: 2 hours, plus 15 minute shuttle each way from downtown Freeport. Trips run Friday, Sunday & Monday 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM - minimum 6 passengers Adults: $50, Children (2-12): $35, Children under 2 Starting at $35 · 2 Hours · Explore the mysteries of Casco Bay!

services.name: Harpswell Lobster Boat Races
services.desc: Join us for a quintessential Maine experience at the Harpswell Lobster Boat Races! For over 30 years, this beloved event has drawn fishermen, boat builders, and race fans from near and far, all eager to soak up the beauty of our coastal venue and enjoy a day of family-friendly fun. 📅 Date: Sunday, July 28th (Rain Date: Sunday, August 4th) 🕙 Start Time: BOAT DEPARTS AT 9:30, races kick off at 10:00 AM Tickets: Tickets are $40 per child (child is 12 and under), $60 per adult ( adult are 12 +). The Pamela B will depart from the Freeport Town Wharf at 9:00 AM, returning by 2:00 PM Pack your 🦞 2024 Harpswell Lobster Boat Races! 🚤

services.name: Coastal Cruise and Lobster Roll
services.desc: Two-hour coastal cruise in Freeport, Maine, with an optional lobster roll meal, snacks, and onboard beer and wine for purchase. Starting at $65 l 2 Hours l Foodie Tour

services.name: Oyster Farm Tour & Lobster Roll
services.desc: If you enjoy oysters & lobster rolls you’ve come to the right place! Every Saturday 11:30 PM & 2:30 PM from mid-June – September, we will meet members from the Mere Point Oyster Company staff in Maquoit Bay serving up lobster rolls alongside the freshest oysters possible. The boat ride is approximatly 40 minutes from Freeport Harbor to Mere Point Oyster Company. We make our way through a series of islands and exposed ledges often covered with seals and shore Starting at $185 l 2 Hours l Fresh Oysters Right From The Sea
